title: CMB non-uniformity from $q$-torsion
html: In the Descartes universe (Descartes universe), the negative Euler characteristic \chi(\mathcal{S}) = -6 forces a non-trivial distribution of angular modes across the CR manifold (Descartes CMB). The q-torsion leaves (q-torsion leaf) imprint a characteristic pattern on the CMB that deviates from the statistically isotropic Gaussian field predicted by \LambdaCDM. Specifically, the q-deformed Reeb flow (q-Reeb flow) introduces torsion into the temperature and polarisation multipoles, producing preferred spiral directions in the B-mode spectrum.
